name: grave moss
note: Grave moss: the graveyard's herb, gathered only at night (docs/39 section 4, Herbalism 7: its kinds unnamed); a placeholder name and kind until Michael names them. Grows like a weed at random on natural ground and comes back elsewhere once gathered (docs/46, src/resources.js); gathered by hand (src/gather.js). Dev art drawn from this design (src/gather-art.js), the item's icon from the same.
